state:
Goal `tools-php-differences`: all 12 features of the chapter have their proofs, and `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:php-differences` lists none. `bun nv owners --closes tools-php-differences` and `bun nv playbook --closes tools-php-differences` were green this session.
The three floor checks the last sweep reported red, `nvs-cli` test `ast`, `nvs-ir` test `refusals` and `nvs-config` test `directives`, pass on this tree: `cargo test --test ast --test refusals --test directives` ran 61 tests and all passed. No test failed in that sweep. It ran all three binaries green, and a `bun nv verify` another agent ran in this tree ended before the sweep judged them and marked their atoms owed.
The sweep now judges a test binary on its own run of it: `binaryGreen` in `tools/nv/driver/runner.ts`. **The running driver loaded `runner.ts` before this change, so it takes effect when the driver is next started.** Until then a by-hand `bun nv verify` in this tree during a sweep can turn a floor `cargo test -p <crate>` check red again; the playbook bullet under Tooling says how to tell.
Five gaps are open and none is owned by this goal: `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-creates-objects-passes-the-memory-limit` (a priority 1 finding), `nvs-ir/a-require-with-a-computed-path-runs-nothing`, `nvs-types/a-never-method-that-reaches-its-end-returns`, `nvs-syntax/a-second-namespace-statement-in-one-file-compiles` and `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops`.
The pack was enough for the item it named. The failing checks needed `tools/nv/driver/runner.ts` and `tools/nv/select/record.ts`, and this goal's `context` field `modules` names neither; it was not widened, because the goal has no feature left.

items.text: **`nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-creates-objects-passes-the-memory-limit`** — find why the back-edge poll does not report a breach under `nvs run` (`rule:testing/a-failing-proof-is-fixed-or-recorded`). The flag is raised at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs:785` only when the thread's ceiling is not `0`, and `crates/nvs-runtime/src/budget.rs:470` returns early on a null polled word; who arms both for a run is not checked. An object is allocated with no budget question at `crates/nvs-runtime/src/object.rs:3856`. The fix removes the marker from `tests/hostile/tools/php-differences/two-spellings-side-by-side/02-a-cart-that-grows-past-the-memory-limit.nvs:6`, and likely closes `a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops` with it.

backlog: `advance` at `tools/nv/select/record.ts:375` marks an atom owed that another process ran green after this process read its selection. `PlanSweep.close` in `tools/nv/driver/runner.ts` already counts such a run as run; `bun nv verify` and `bun nv proofs --verify` do not. Owner: the module comment of `tools/nv/select/record.ts`.

`judgeSuite` in `tools/nv/driver/runner.ts` reads each case's verdict from the store after the sweep ran it, as the test judge did. Whether a concurrent `bun nv verify` turns a suite red the same way is not checked. Owner: the module comment of `tools/nv/driver/runner.ts`.
Which goal owns each of the five open gaps is not checked: `bun nv proofs --gaps` lists them, and each record under `data/gaps/` names its owner.
